_rule: The cell gauge's marks, the single source the chain's report draws from (2026-10-13, author: 'placing it back in the report will help you remember'). Every value must match the book's gauge table, docs/book/part6/p6_06_gauge.tex, where the full surface is computed by verify_book.py; CANON/status_check.py refuses a mismatch. The DIRECTION is CANON/foundation.json entry gauge_direction, remembered by the black hole: right is over-writing toward the full surface; left of Normal is more order than healthy; below the floor identity can no longer be held.

floor.book_anchor: is at $1\times10^{-7}$ on both rows, off the left edge
floor.label: floor H_min: thermal kicks win against one ATP. Below it identity can no longer be held

normal.label: Normal: the cell working as itself

breach.label: breach: to be measured, from tumor/normal pairs, the DNMT1-inhibitor series and blood cancers

full_surface.label: full surface: every identity site at a coin flip - the 2D surface is full and past it the reading turns over

left_region: writes less than healthy: more order (senescence reads here)
right_region: over-writing toward the full surface: the black hole side, where cancer sits

normal_by_instrument._note: IAM-A has no healthy band of its own yet (COM-IAMA-054); Met-A's band is not borrowed (author 2026-10-15). A band is drawn only where it was measured.

reading: Left end, the floor (H_min): the least holding work that still keeps a cell's identity. Going left past it, a cell can no longer hold its identity. Derived: one full ATP per site against thermal kicks.
Left of healthy: more order than healthy cells. Senescence reads here.
Healthy: where purified healthy cells of this type read. Measured, not chosen.
Right of healthy: over-writing. The record fills up toward the full surface, the black-hole side. Cancer sits here. It has not lost its identity; it is writing too much error.
Right end, the ceiling (full surface): every identity site at a coin flip, 1 bit per site. Derived.
misreading: A misreading to avoid. It was made more than three times while this gauge was being built, so it is printed on every report: the floor is NOT the most a cell can hold, and cancer does NOT lose its identity. The floor is the least holding that still keeps identity; left of it, identity cannot be held. Cancer moves right, toward the ceiling.

forbidden._rule: CANON/gauge_words.py refuses these on every presentation surface unless a negation (not, never, no longer, retired, wrong) stands just before them
